meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 帮你检查或配置 claude-mem 与 cmem.ai Pro 的云同步:写入同步 token、user id、SyncHub URL 三项连接值,重启 worker 后验证并报告设备 id、待同步数量、上次刷写时间和错误。
howto.when: 当你提到“设置云同步”、“同步我的记忆”、“cmem pro”等说法,或想把记忆数据库备份、同步到 cmem.ai 账号时触发。

say.text: 检查一下我的云同步状态
say.note: 查询 worker 端口并返回同步状态

say.text: 帮我把记忆同步到 cmem.ai 账号
重新配置我的云同步连接
say.note: 写入三项连接值并重启验证

howto.what_en: Checks or sets up claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro: writes the sync token, user id and SyncHub URL, restarts the worker, then verifies and reports device id, pending counts, last flush and errors.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro" and similar, or want your memory database backed up or synced to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Queries the worker port and returns status

say_en.text: Sync my memories to my cmem.ai account
say_en.note: Asks for token, user id and SyncHub URL
Writes the three values and restarts to verify
